title: Completed affine principal-open section localization
statement: Let A and C be commutative rings, φ:A→C, E an affine scheme, s:E→Spec C, and f∈A. Put W=s⁻¹D(φ(f)) and give Γ(E,W) its structural C-action. The localization at f of the restricted A-module completedSectionModule s [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules] is A-linearly equivalent to Γ(E,W) restricted along φ. This equivalence commutes with the localized C-action of [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data]. No completion, overlap data, or tensor product is needed.

source.place: Tags 01HR, Lemma 26.5.4(3)-(5), and 0BLH, principal-open section localization.

proof.text: Define the structural homomorphisms χ:C→B=Γ(E,top), ρ:B→Γ(E,W) and ψ:C→Γ(E,W). Their composite identity is definitional. Identify W with E.basicOpen(χ(φ(f))) by Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top and basicOpen_eq_of_affine. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen and Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers make Γ(E,W) a localization of B at the image of the powers of f.

Use the ring-localization module instance and IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right to identify restriction as a localization of the fixed restricted A-module. IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv constructs e from this map and LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap.

For each z:C compare e composed with localization of multiplication by χ(z), and multiplication by ψ(z) composed with e. IsLocalizedModule.ext reduces their equality to the original sections, where it is ρ(χ(z)m)=ψ(z)ρ(m). The chosen localized C-action equals localized multiplication on each fraction by exists_localized_s_module.choose_spec and IsLocalizedModule.map_LocalizedModules. Evaluation of the equality of maps proves the scalar identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_completed_affine_section_localization
    {A C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing C]
    (φ : A →+* C) {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine E] (s : E ⟶ Spec (.of C)) (f : A) :
    let W := s ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (φ f)
    letI : Module C Γ(E, W) := Module.compHom _
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop ≫
        E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
    let N := ModuleCat.of C Γ(E, W)
    ∃ e : FormalGlueing.localize f (FormalGlueing.restrict φ (completedSectionModule s)) ≃ₗ[A]
        FormalGlueing.restrict φ N,
      ∀ (z : C) x,
        e ((FormalGlueing.localizedSModule φ f (completedSectionModule s)).smul z x) =
          z • (e x : N)
